data.name: CR5_001
data.value: (So this is it. The Shattered Ruins.)

data.name: CR5_002
data.value: We're here... The expedition's final objective.

data.name: CR5_003
data.value: There you are! We were starting to wonder if the wind had swallowed you.

data.name: CR5_004
data.value: Reinier and I arrived yesterday. We already know these ruins—we've walked them end to end, every way there is.

data.name: CR5_005
data.value: We searched them top to bottom... and understood nothing.

data.name: CR5_006
data.value: It's a total mystery. Every corridor looks like the last one, and yet it isn't.

data.name: CR5_007
data.value: Welcome to the Shattered Ruins camp. Everyone's here, as planned.

data.name: CR5_008
data.value: Settle in. We have a lot to say to each other before we go in.

data.name: CR5_009
data.value: Look. The main entrance, over there. The dark veins running across the stone... they all lead downward, inside.

data.name: CR5_010
data.value: (The veins... Like the ones Tornadus spoke of. A shape beneath the world.)

data.name: CR5_011
data.value: Dinner's ready. Eat first. We'll talk after.

data.name: CR5_012
data.value: Before we enter these ruins, I want to hear from each of you. Everything you've seen since the expedition began.

data.name: CR5_013
data.value: I'll start. The Crucible, first: the lava followed no natural rhythm. It rose and fell, as if it were breathing.

data.name: CR5_014
data.value: Then the storm at the summit. A sky that didn't turn by chance. And beneath it all, these veins... converging.

data.name: CR5_015
data.value: I saw trees withering by the roadside, in full season. Their roots, grey. As if drained from within.

data.name: CR5_016
data.value: As for the ruins, I'll speak for them. We called them 'Twisted', because nothing in them is straight. The walls, the corridors, even the stones. Everything leans.

data.name: CR5_017
data.value: And yet, beneath the stone... something pulses. You feel it when you press your paw to the ground.

data.name: CR5_018
data.value: My rear mind says these ruins weren't built by Pokémon. They were CARVED. Around something. Something meant to be kept.

data.name: CR5_019
data.value: And if a guardian waits at the bottom... it has been watching for a very, very long time.

data.name: CR5_020
data.value: (Tornadus said a shape lives beneath the world. And that the veins converge toward the north. Here.)

data.name: CR5_021
data.value: Wait... You mean these ruins would be the meeting point? Of ALL the veins?

data.name: CR5_022
data.value: I say we came all this way, so we're not turning back at a doorway. That's not my style.

data.name: CR5_023
data.value: Easy to say when you haven't seen what pulses beneath the stone.

data.name: CR5_024
data.value: Come on, Ganlon! We're the team that crossed the steppe, the tunnel, and a whole mountain! We've seen worse than ruins.

data.name: CR5_025
data.value: Camp protocol respected, woof! Fire, guard, rations: everything's in order for tomorrow.

data.name: CR5_026
data.value: And I saved a piece of pie for everyone. You don't walk into a dungeon on an empty stomach—that's what my mother says.

data.name: CR5_027
data.value: Let's put the pieces together. A heat that breathes. Trees drained of their sap. Veins converging beneath the earth. And at the end, these ruins. Everything leads here.

data.name: CR5_028
data.value: Then tomorrow we'll learn what these ruins guard. And if they guard something living... we'll know why the whole world seems to have gathered here.

data.name: CR5_029
data.value: (The pieces are coming together. And I feel they form something great. Something very great.)

data.name: CR5_030
data.value: Decision made. Tomorrow, at dawn, we enter the Shattered Ruins. Tonight, we all sleep here. Rest: this is the last camp before the unknown.

data.name: CR5_031
data.value: Look at the ruins, over there. They look like they've been waiting forever. And tonight, it's us they were waiting for.

data.name: CR5_032
data.value: (Tomorrow, we'll know. Whatever is at the bottom, we'll face it.)

data.name: CR5_033
data.value: The fire dies down gently. The camp falls asleep at the foot of the Shattered Ruins.

data.name: CR5_034
data.value: Tomorrow, we go in. Do you feel that weight too? As if the whole expedition led here.

data.name: CR5_035
data.value: We crossed half the region for this. We're not backing down now.

data.name: CR5_036
data.value: And whatever is at the bottom, {0}, we'll find it. Together. As always...

data.name: CR5_D01
data.value: ...As always, we...[pause=20] we...

data.name: CR5_D02
data.value: (...And he fell asleep mid-sentence. I guess the day wore him out.)

data.name: CR5_037
data.value: The ruins watch over the sleeping camp. The night wraps around them.

data.name: CR5_038
data.value: (...A silhouette. A light. Who...[pause=15] who was that?)

data.name: CR5_039
data.value: (I keep seeing that shape... but I can't catch it.)

data.name: CR5_040
data.value: (She said something...[pause=10] about me. About what I've become.)

data.name: CR5_041
data.value: You're awake? You looked... elsewhere. Seems sleep didn't give everything back.

data.name: CR5_042
data.value: The sun rises over the ruins. The stone catches fire. It feels like they're watching us.

data.name: CR5_043
data.value: Day has broken, and with it, the last leg of our expedition. The Shattered Ruins await.

data.name: CR5_044
data.value: We go in together. We come out together. Whatever is at the bottom, we'll face it head-on.

data.name: CR5_045
data.value: So... here we go. The Shattered Ruins, here we come.

data.name: CR5_046
data.value: (Let's go. And whatever is in there, we'll face it.)

data.name: CR5_H01
data.value: Hey... did you see the veins on the stone? They look like roots. Roots that go down, straight into the dark.

data.name: CR5_H02
data.value: My grandmother used to say ruins swallow travelers who don't listen. I thought it was a joke.

data.name: CR5_H03
data.value: I heard worse. They say under these ruins, something stirs. Something old, waiting for us to leave.

data.name: CR5_H04
data.value: But nobody knows what. That's the worst part. We don't even know if it's a monster, or just... the earth.

data.name: CR5_H05
data.value: BOTH OF YOU! I can hear that from my bed. We sleep, we don't tell ghost stories!

data.name: CR5_H06
data.value: Take after {0}. He's already asleep. As always.

data.name: CR5_H07
data.value: (...And of course, the only one truly asleep is the one being held up as an example.)

data.name: CR5_H08
data.value: ...Yeah, alright. We're sleeping. Promise.

data.name: CR5_D03
data.value: (The ruins watch over us. Tomorrow, we'll pay them a visit.)

data.name: CR5_B01
data.value: Hmph... Grey trees, pulsing veins... Do you hear yourselves? Sounds like a bad dream.

data.name: CR5_B02
data.value: A bad dream doesn't leave marks on bark, Ganlon. Trees do. I saw the grooves.

data.name: CR5_B03
data.value: Right. Simple question: what do we do tomorrow if all this is true? We go in, and then?

data.name: CR5_B04
data.value: We go in, and we see what waits at the bottom. My rear mind says we won't be the only ones heading down. Better to know that now.

data.name: CR5_B05
data.value: Small correction, Kino: we called them 'Twisted' because nothing in them is straight. But 'Shattered'—that was your find, in front of the rift. Don't forget your own discovery.

data.name: CR5_B06
data.value: And you forget it was you holding the torch that day. Without you, I'd have fallen into the first crevice.

data.name: CR5_K01
data.value: Easy, easy... Don't get up all at once. You took quite a hit in there.

data.name: CR5_K02
data.value: I've laid out berries and poultices. You'll move when I say so, not before.

data.name: CR5_K03
data.value: The ruins turned you back. It happens to the best teams. What matters is you came back whole.

data.name: CR5_K04
data.value: We're not going back to the guild. We rebuild here, at camp. And we try again when you're ready.

data.name: CR5_K05
data.value: Ouch... The first room was already a wall. We weren't prepared enough, that's all.

data.name: CR5_K06
data.value: But we are now, {0}. We know what awaits. And we'll come back smarter.

data.name: CR5_K07
data.value: The ruins don't cut anyone slack. I needed three tries to reach the bottom. Falling is normal.

data.name: CR5_K08
data.value: Falling isn't what matters. It's what you do after. And you two look like the kind who get back up.

data.name: CR5_K09
data.value: Rest. Eat. Next time we go in with what we learned. The camp is ready, and so are we.

data.name: CR5_R01
data.value: There you are. In one piece—that's what matters. A retreat isn't a defeat: it's a decision.

data.name: CR5_R02
data.value: Welcome back to camp. Sit by the fire. We'll talk about what's next once you catch your breath.

data.name: CR5_R03
data.value: We went as far as we could today. The corridors were turning... bad. We chose to come back.

data.name: CR5_R04
data.value: Wise call. The ruins aren't going anywhere. They've waited a thousand years: they can wait one more night.

data.name: CR5_R05
data.value: What you saw in there, hold onto it. Each attempt brings you closer to what pulses at the bottom.

data.name: CR5_R06
data.value: You did right. Me, first time, I nearly got stuck in a corridor that wouldn't stop moving. Coming back isn't giving up.

data.name: CR5_R07
data.value: Besides, we have everything we need here: a fire, food, and the best team in the region. Tomorrow will be a better day.

data.name: CR5_R08
data.value: So here's the plan: we rest, we restock, and we try again when you're recovered. The Shattered Ruins won't make us back down.
